DESIGN TO DELIVERY

Yashmeen Future Building brings Dubai fit-out delivery together under one team. Design, spatial engineering, bespoke joinery, architectural glazing, and authority approvals move together under one accountable team, from the first brief to site handover.

In our 35,000 sq. ft. Al Quoz atelier, craftspeople fabricate custom millwork, curved timber, metalwork and acoustic panels. Our MEP and site teams carry those details into the finished space, keeping the approved design and the built result connected.

(03)
Dubai Authority Approvals

Direct submission and expedited clearances through Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, Tecom, and Master Developers.

(04)
Bespoke Joinery & Factory Fabrication

Precision millwork, timber panelling, and metalwork fabricated in our 35,000 sq.ft Al Quoz manufacturing facility.

(05)
Turnkey Site Construction & MEP Integration

Comprehensive site execution with dedicated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering on a single critical path.

(06)
Snag-Free Handover & 12-Month Guarantee

Full testing, commissioning approvals, operation manuals, and an unconditional 12-month defect liability guarantee.

CAPABILITIES & SCOPE
Integrated Disciplines Under One Roof

Operating our own 35,000 sq.ft manufacturing facility in Al Quoz eliminates subcontractor markups, prevents schedule delays, and maintains absolute control over fit-out quality.

Space Planning

Smart layouts that improve flow, light and usability in every room.

Concept & Mood Boards

Colour palettes, textures and references that define the look and feel of your space.

3D Visualisation

Photo-realistic renders so you can see the finished interior before it is built.

Materials & Finishes

Careful selection of flooring, wall finishes, lighting and fittings that suit your design and budget.

Furniture & Decor

Furniture, curtains, artwork and accessories sourced or custom-made to complete the space.

Bespoke Joinery

Wardrobes, kitchens, wall panelling and feature pieces crafted to your exact measurements.

METHODOLOGY
How We Deliver From Brief to Handover

A transparent, milestone-driven execution framework engineered to prevent budget creep and ensure smooth authority approvals.

01
Consultation

We learn how you live or work, your taste and your budget.

02
Concept & Layout

Mood boards and space plans are presented and refined together.

03
3D & Detailing

Renders, drawings and material schedules are finalised for approval.

04
Fit-Out & Styling

Our team builds, installs joinery, and styles the finished space.

05
Handover

A final walkthrough and snagging so everything meets the design.
